edges.subject: enzymatic deficiency
edges.quote: Inherited metabolic disorders are monogenetic diseases caused by enzymatic or structural deficiencies affecting the lysosomal or peroxisomal metabolic activity.

edges.subject: metabolic defect
edges.quote: The metabolic defect can primarily affect the central nervous system, leading to neuronal death, microglial activation, inflammatory demyelination, and axonal degeneration.

edges.subject: gene therapy
edges.quote: This review provides an overview of the GT strategies currently under clinical investigation for neurometabolic lysosomal and peroxisomal storage diseases, such as adrenoleukodystrophy and metachromatic leukodystrophy, as well as novel emerging indications such as mucopolysaccharidoses, gangliosidoses, and neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses, with a comprehensive elucidation of the main features and mechanisms at the basis of a successful GT approach for these devastating diseases.
